transcript: When I was in middle school, I was bullied Going to the classroom was a horror When the alarm rang in the morning, tears would pour out The incident that triggered it was so small that no one could guess At the school sports day, my team lost a relay match and finished last From there, one teammate began to blame me And gradually the atmosphere of the class changed Garbage was placed inside my desk My gym uniform was dumped into the toilet No one would speak to me When I reported the matter to a teacher I was dismissed with It's merely teasing I was too embarrassed To confess to my parents A sense of shame made me carry it alone One day, I simply could not go to school My mother at first showed anger But seeing my face, she understood everything Working with the school, my homeroom teacher was changed Several classmates came to apologize to me I still remember the weight of the words So I am truly sorry Bullying eats at the heart of not only the victim But also the one who bullies One of those who had bullied me, contacted me years later I have been regretting it all this time He said the wound hasn't completely disappeared But that experience made the person I am today A person who knows weakness can be kinder to another's weakness The experience of suffering can become a strength that may someday relieve someone else Now, as a teacher, I keep telling children, you are not alone You

segments.text: When I was in middle school, I was bullied
Going to the classroom was a horror
When the alarm rang in the morning, tears would pour out
The incident that triggered it was so small that no one could guess
At the school sports day, my team lost a relay match and finished last
From there, one teammate began to blame me
And gradually the atmosphere of the class changed
Garbage was placed inside my desk
My gym uniform was dumped into the toilet
No one would speak to me
When I reported the matter to a teacher
I was dismissed with
It's merely teasing
I was too embarrassed
To confess to my parents
A sense of shame made me carry it alone
One day, I simply could not go to school
My mother at first showed anger But seeing my face, she understood everything
Working with the school, my homeroom teacher was changed
Several classmates came to apologize to me I still remember the weight of the words
So I am truly sorry
Bullying eats at the heart of not only the victim
But also the one who bullies
One of those who had bullied me, contacted me years later
I have been regretting it all this time
He said the wound hasn't completely disappeared
But that experience made the person I am today
A person who knows weakness can be kinder to another's weakness
The experience of suffering can become a strength that may someday relieve someone else
Now, as a teacher, I keep telling children, you are not alone
You
